our_message_content: The university strives to provide distinguished education and innovative technical research to meet the cognitive, research, and societal demands of the modern era.
president_content: 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, and in Him we seek assistance. To my dear students, and to all staff and faculty members of the University of Technology across their respective roles and positions: The University of Technology possesses a rich history...'
relations_content: The Department of Public Relations and Media was established following the decree issued by the University President in 2024, in accordance with defined objectives to serve as a reflection of the university's various activities.
